AuthSessionRequest.description: Versioned, credential-free browser-session mutation body. Bootstrap proof and session cookie remain transport-only.

AuthSessionResponse.description: Secret-free current browser-session context. Scopes are bounded, current, and ordered by canonical scope identity.

ChatInputInteractionProjection.description: Secret-safe pending input projection. It excludes Worker envelopes, provider data, credentials, and raw tool payloads.

ChatInteractionBindingProjection.description: Complete public interaction binding. The Control Plane validates equality across every duplicated identity before accepting a decision.

ChatMessageProjection.description: Secret-safe product message projection. It excludes provider requests, provider responses, tool payloads, credentials, and Codex internals.

CollaborationActivityProjection.description: Durable collaboration activity reference. It contains no raw provider payload or credential material.

CollaborationPresenceUpdatePayload.description: online and away require a lease duration; offline requires null. The application rejects every other pair.

CommandCompletedEnvelope.description: Shared completed-command envelope. Public responses use the command-discriminated CommandCompletedResponse union.

CommandCompletedResponse.description: Exact command/result response union. Relabeling a result under another command is invalid.

ControlPlaneEventId.description: Stable identity of one persisted Control Plane event, independent of transport.

ControlPlaneWebSocketChatInteractionsInv.description: Secret-safe invalidation. Browsers reload Control Plane interaction and approval snapshots; no Worker payload is carried over WebSocket.

ControlPlaneWebSocketDeliveryStageRuntim.description: Delivery-stage invalidation. The browser reloads Delivery first and replays runtime at the exact returned StrongFlowReadCursor.

ControlPlaneWebSocketEnterpriseAuditInva.description: Secret-safe audit invalidation. The browser reloads only the named bounded enterprise query.

ControlPlaneWebSocketEnterpriseFleetInva.description: Secret-safe fleet invalidation. The browser reloads only the named bounded enterprise query.

ControlPlaneWebSocketEnterpriseIntegrati.description: Secret-safe integration invalidation. The browser reloads only the named bounded enterprise query.

ControlPlaneWebSocketEnterpriseMembershi.description: Secret-safe membership invalidation. The browser reloads only the named bounded enterprise query.

ControlPlaneWebSocketEnterpriseOrganizat.description: Secret-safe organization invalidation. The browser reloads only the named bounded enterprise query.

ControlPlaneWebSocketEnterprisePolicyInv.description: Secret-safe policy invalidation. The browser reloads only the named bounded enterprise query.

ControlPlaneWebSocketEnterpriseProjectIn.description: Secret-safe project invalidation. The browser reloads only the named bounded enterprise query.

ControlPlaneWebSocketEnterpriseRoleInval.description: Secret-safe role invalidation. The browser reloads only the named bounded enterprise query.

ControlPlaneWebSocketEnterpriseTeamInval.description: Secret-safe team invalidation. The browser reloads only the named bounded enterprise query.

ControlPlaneWebSocketEnterpriseUsageInva.description: Secret-safe usage invalidation. The browser reloads only the named bounded enterprise query.

ControlPlaneWebSocketProductSessionMessa.description: Secret-safe Chat projection only; excludes raw provider, tool, credential, and Codex payloads.

ControlPlaneWebSocketProductSessionRunti.description: Chat/product-session invalidation. It has no Delivery identity or StrongFlow read cursor and reloads only its product-session runtime projection.

ControlPlaneWebSocketResetRequiredFrame.description: Generic transport reset. The client discards partial state and selects a complete reload from its saved original subscription stream; the frame does not pretend every stream is a Delivery.

ControlPlaneWebSocketRuntimeProjectionIn.description: Strictly discriminated runtime invalidation. Product-session Chat reloads runtime alone; a Delivery stage establishes one bounded StrongFlow read cut before runtime replay.

ControlPlaneWebSocketSessionExecutionWor.description: Execution-worker source for a session-scoped event. The block must exactly join the event payload.

ControlPlaneWebSocketSubscribeOrigin.description: Explicit subscription origin used when no HTTP snapshot cursor is available.

ControlPlaneWebSocketSubscribeStartAt.description: Exact start point: a named origin or the cursor returned by the HTTP snapshot.

CredentialReferenceProjection.description: Secret-safe lifecycle metadata only: responses never include secret material or vault locator.

CredentialReferenceRotatePayload.description: Binds an already-atomically-rotated secret-store version to lifecycle metadata. The locator is write-only and is never persisted in the Credential reference aggregate.

DeliveryApproveTaskBreakdownPayload.description: Promotes the ordered task proposals from the exact sealed approved review set. The caller cannot submit or replace task fields.

reviewSetSha256.description: Stale-check assertion for the current sealed approved SolutionReviewProjection; it is not caller-authored task content.

DeliveryAttentionProjection.description: Safe Attention projection. Canonical protocol context is never returned.

DeliveryDetailProjection.description: StrongFlow detail read model. It is a closed projection, not a mutable Delivery entity.

DeliveryEventReadCursor.description: Exact position in one repository-scoped Delivery event stream. Empty streams use sequence zero with null eventId; positive positions require the persisted event ID.

DeliveryEvidenceProjection.description: Evidence stores a bounded source reference, never copied runtime logs or command output.

atCursor.description: Optional server-issued cursor for an exact replay. Omit it to establish a new bounded StrongFlow read cut.

DeliveryStageProjection.description: Human review stages never receive an ExecutionJob SessionBinding. Every Codex StageRun has its ProductSession/ExecutionJob binding; only WorkerSession/CodexThread attachment may remain pending.

DeliveryStageSessionBindingProjection.description: A ProductSession/ExecutionJob binding remains visible before Worker/Codex attachment; a CodexThread is never present without its WorkerSession.

allOf.description: Repository-scoped stale-check request. The authenticated actor, complete repository scope, requestId, and expectedRevision form the command boundary.

DeliverySubmitVerdictPayload.description: Requests server-side verdict computation from sealed Control Plane facts. Caller-derived Evidence, criterion results, verdicts, Attention, status, credentials, verification conclusions, and raw runtime facts are rejected.

candidateDigest.description: Current frozen candidate digest used for stale-check only; it is not Evidence, a verdict, or an authorization fact.

DeliveryTaskProposalProjection.description: One ordered planner task proposal sealed into reviewSetSha256. Approval promotes these exact fields with owner null and status pending; planner-supplied ownership and HTTP replacement task content are rejected.

EnterpriseApiTokenProjection.description: Secret-free API Token metadata. Raw token material and its SHA-256 verifier are never returned.

EnterpriseAuditPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseExternalIdentityProjection.description: Secret-free external subject binding. Authentication maps it to one canonical User Actor.

EnterpriseFleetPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseIdentityPage.description: One stable, bounded organization identity page; it never contains token verifier or raw token material.

EnterpriseIdentityUpdatePayload.description: Identity mutation. API Token callers generate the raw wwc_api token locally and submit only its SHA-256 verifier.

EnterpriseIntegrationPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseIntegrationUpdatePayload.description: Configuration contains secret-safe settings and credential references only; raw secrets are rejected.

configuration.description: Closed secret-safe integration settings. Credentials are referenced separately and URL queries/fragments are not accepted.

EnterpriseMembershipPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseOrganizationPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterprisePermission.description: Closed least-privilege permission vocabulary. There is no wildcard permission.

EnterprisePolicyDefinition.description: Closed, secret-free policy rule manifest; condition bodies are stored and audited by their canonical digest.

childOverrideMode.description: Only an organization-scoped active policy may authorize explicit child relaxation.

EnterprisePolicyPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterprisePolicyVersionReference.description: Exact immutable policy version seal used for inheritance and relaxation authority.

EnterprisePolicyVersionSource.description: Authenticated source of one immutable policy version.

EnterpriseProjectRepositoryPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

EnterpriseProjectRepositoryUpdatePayload.description: repositoryId is required exactly when kind is repository; the application rejects a mismatched pair.

EnterpriseRoleAssignment.description: Exact role-version grant. Nullable time bounds represent a permanent grant; descendants is evaluated only inside the authenticated organization boundary.

EnterpriseRolePage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable role-authority snapshot.

EnterpriseServiceAccountProjection.description: Secret-free Service Account identity. Its API Token digests are never part of this projection.

EnterpriseTeamPage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable team-authority snapshot.

EnterpriseUsagePage.description: One bounded, cursor-bound page from a stable enterprise management snapshot.

ErrorDetails.description: Machine-readable error facts. Authority-sensitive property names are rejected recursively at the public boundary.

ErrorDetailValue.description: A recursive JSON value whose object branches apply the public error redaction rules.

EventReadCursor.description: Transport-neutral exact stream position carried from a complete snapshot into event subscription.

EventReadPosition.description: Last persisted sequence included in a snapshot or event-stream baseline; zero represents an empty stream.

EventReadStream.description: One exact ordered Control Plane event stream shared by snapshot and push transports.

ExecutionEventId.description: Stable identity retained when a runtime event is replayed.

ExecutionJobId.description: Identity of one scheduler-owned execution job.

ExecutionJobReplacementAuthority.description: Control Plane seal for one exact predecessor-to-successor Job replacement. The predecessor lease and optional bound session also authorize exact continuation of an already durable Artifact stream; they never authorize a new stream.

predecessorSessionIdentity.description: The exact slot-bound predecessor WorkerSession and CodexThread. Null means no predecessor slot-bound runtime exists; the predecessor dispatch may have been accepted, but null authorizes neither dirty-workspace reuse nor continuation of an old runtime or Artifact stream.

ExecutionMessageId.description: Unique identity of one ExecutionPort message envelope.

ExecutionPortMessage.description: The single versioned message union shared by local and remote ExecutionPort adapters.
ExecutionPortMessage.title: ExecutionPortMessage

FencingToken.description: Monotonically increasing decimal token encoded as a string to preserve 64-bit precision.

FrozenCandidateSummaryProjection.description: Bounded current candidate identity. Changed paths, hunks, and diff bytes require a separate authorized detail endpoint.

GitHubRepositorySlug.description: GitHub owner/repository without URL syntax, userinfo, query, fragment, or credentials.

InputRequestId.description: Identity of one interactive input request.

InputRequestMessage.description: Requests one typed user input through the Control Plane product session.
InputRequestMessage.title: input.request

InputRespondPayload.description: Control Plane validates the complete binding before emitting one ExecutionPort input.response.

InputResponseMessage.description: Returns a typed input result without exposing product-session storage.
InputResponseMessage.title: input.response

InteractiveInputValue.description: Bound user response value; never an ExecutionPort message or command payload.

JobCancelAckMessage.description: Acknowledges cancellation without declaring a Delivery result.
JobCancelAckMessage.title: job.cancel_ack

JobCancelMessage.description: Requests cooperative cancellation for the currently fenced attempt.
JobCancelMessage.title: job.cancel

JobDispatchMessage.description: Dispatches one immutable job payload under one attempt and lease.
JobDispatchMessage.title: job.dispatch

JobDispatchResultMessage.description: Returns the idempotent result of accepting or rejecting a job dispatch.
JobDispatchResultMessage.title: job.dispatch_result

JobOutcomeAckMessage.description: Accepts or rejects one lease-fenced execution outcome idempotently.
JobOutcomeAckMessage.title: job.outcome_ack

JobOutcomeMessage.description: Reports an execution outcome; Control Plane alone derives canonical Delivery state and verdicts.
JobOutcomeMessage.title: job.outcome

LeaseEventReadCursor.description: Exact position in one worker lease event stream. Empty streams use sequence zero with null eventId; positive positions require the persisted event ID.

LeaseRenewMessage.description: Extends one lease for the same Worker instance, attempt, and fencing token.
LeaseRenewMessage.title: lease.renew

ModelAckMessage.description: Acknowledges model chunks and requests replay after a stream interruption.

ModelChunkMessage.description: Streams one opaque provider-neutral model response chunk.
ModelChunkMessage.title: model.chunk

ModelExchangeId.description: Identity of one provider-neutral model stream exchange.

ModelOpenMessage.description: Opens one provider-neutral model exchange through the Control Plane gateway.
ModelOpenMessage.title: model.open

OpaqueCursor.description: Opaque cursor bound to scope, query, filters, and one stable snapshot.

ProductSessionEventReadCursor.description: Exact position in one repository-scoped ProductSession event stream. Empty streams use sequence zero with null eventId; positive positions require the persisted event ID.

PublicationProjection.description: Bounded publication summary joined to one current Delivery, Spec, candidate, passing verdict, approval, and target. Remote resources use a closed GitHub identity, never an arbitrary URL or provider payload.

PublicationResourceRef.description: Secret-safe remote publication identity. Control Plane verifies repository equals PublicationTarget.repository and resolves links from kind plus number.

QueryEnvelope.description: Side-effect-free query. Authenticated identity must equal actor and authorize scope.

QueryResultEnvelope.description: Shared query-result envelope. Public responses use the query-discriminated QueryResultResponse union.

QueryResultResponse.description: Exact query/result response union. A client can narrow result by query without accepting an unrelated projection.

RuntimeAckMessage.description: Acknowledges the highest contiguous runtime event and requests a gap replay when needed.
RuntimeAckMessage.title: runtime.ack

RuntimeDiffSummaryProjection.description: Live execution exposes counts and a source reference only; paths, hunks, and unified diff bytes are excluded.

RuntimeEventMessage.description: Publishes one ordered, replayable, provider-neutral runtime fact.
RuntimeEventMessage.title: runtime.event

RuntimeProjectionEventCursor.description: Exact event baseline for a ProductSession runtime snapshot or Delivery-stage runtime snapshot.

RuntimeProjectionSnapshot.description: Complete bounded typed projection used after restart, invalidation, or WebSocket reset. eventCursor is the only lossless handoff to the first subscription.

eventCursor.description: Exact WebSocket stream position represented by this complete snapshot.

RuntimeReplayRequestMessage.description: Requests original runtime events strictly after the acknowledged sequence.
RuntimeReplayRequestMessage.title: runtime.replay_request

RuntimeSessionProjection.description: One deterministic StrongFlow session projection built only from an exact accepted runtime binding.

RuntimeUsageProjection.description: Usage totals are sorted by metric name before publication.

ScopeEventReadCursor.description: Exact position in one scope-wide event stream. Empty streams use sequence zero with null eventId; positive positions require the persisted event ID.

SessionBindingMessage.description: Authoritative WorkerSession-to-CodexThread binding for one exact active Job lease. Delivery-stage bindings carry the exact StageRun; ProductSession Chat bindings omit it.

stageRunId.description: Exact Delivery StageRun identity. ProductSession Chat bindings omit this field.

SessionBindingMessage.title: session.binding

SessionBindingSourceIdentity.description: Stable source identity that produced a SessionBinding.

SessionIdentity.description: Identity of one executable session. Delivery-stage sessions carry StageRun; ProductSession Chat sessions omit it.

SolutionReviewProjection.description: Current validated solution review, including pending review content and the ordered task proposals sealed into reviewSetSha256. Human review has no ExecutionJob SessionBinding.

taskProposals.description: Canonical order is part of reviewSetSha256 and is preserved during task promotion.

StrongFlowReadCursor.description: Server-issued, fully comparable StrongFlow read cut. Its authenticated token seals every field including eventCursor. Revision zero is the explicit no-publication ledger state; wall-clock generation time is never a cursor coordinate.

eventCursor.description: Exact Delivery event stream position included in the authenticated read-cut token.

token.description: Opaque authenticated token issued by the Control Plane for these exact read coordinates.

WorkerHeartbeatAckMessage.description: Acknowledges exactly one heartbeat without dispatching jobs as a side effect.

WorkerRegistrationResultMessage.description: Returns the idempotent registration result and restart lease recovery rule.

sessionCookie.description: Same-origin Web and local Host session.
